children: Mannatech appointed Robert Toth as Chairman of the Board effective September 1, 2026, as J. Stanley Fredrick retires as Chairman for personal reasons.
Chairman of the Board; Vice Chairman and Class III director (current)
Personal reasons; not due to any disagreement with the Company
Replaced by Robert Toth as Chairman

Appointed to Board and as Vice Chairman Dec 1, 2024; previously served on Board Mar 2008–May 31, 2023; former chair of Compensation & Stock Option Plan Committee; served on Audit, Nominating/Governance & Compliance, Science & Marketing Committees; Vice Chairman Aug 2014–Mar 2019.
Will serve as Chairman; other committee roles noted in background
Board retainer to continue through December 31, 2026

As non-employee director: standard director compensation; Year 1 as chairman: additional $50,000 cash and $50,000 equity (grant deferred until shares available); Years 2–3: additional $100,000 fee each year
